title: Most might/wits/grace/will checks (force the strongbox, force the font's bolt, work out the wind carvings, press for it plainly, etc.) can be retried immediately for free on failure with no cooldown or consequence, so failure rarely mattered outside the handful of checks explicitly flagged 'fail costs Nhp'.
where: general (e.g. The King's Strongroom, The Chapel of Ash, the Old Watchtower)
